name: com.perpmetric/perpmetric
title: PerpMetric perpetuals data
description: Perp futures data for Hyperliquid, Aster and Lighter: screener, funding, breadth, freshness.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Freshness and coverage of PerpMetric data for each venue. Call this first when timing matters, or when another tool reports 'degraded'/'stale' data. Cheap.

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Current metrics for every market on one venue in one normalized schema: price, returns (1m-24h), funding (raw, hourly %, APR %), open interest USD and change, 24h volume, mark-oracle/index basis. Sort and filter server-side to get top movers, funding extremes or OI expansion without pulling the full universe. Returned as columns+rows to save tokens.

venue.description: Exchange. hyperliquid = Hyperliquid (Core + HIP-3), aster = Aster, lighter = Lighter.

market_set.description: Hyperliquid only: core perps or HIP-3 builder-deployed markets (e.g. xyz:TSLA). Ignored for other venues.

order.description: abs = largest absolute value first (both directions).

min_volume_24h_usd.description: Drop illiquid markets below this 24h USD volume.

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: Side-by-side price, funding (normalized to hourly % and APR %), open interest, volume and basis for one asset on Hyperliquid, Aster and Lighter, plus the funding spread between venues. Use for cross-venue funding or basis analysis.

symbol.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE.

tools.name: find_funding_spreads
tools.description: Every asset listed on two or more venues, ranked by the gap in annualized funding (APR %) between its highest- and lowest-paying venue, with open interest and volume per leg. One call instead of compare_venues per asset. Gross differential only, not a trade signal.

min_oi_usd.description: Minimum open interest per venue leg.

tools.name: explain_market
tools.description: One-call briefing for an asset: price, 1h/24h change, funding, open interest and basis on every venue, the funding spread, a plain reading of price vs open interest, and (with a key) the market's active unusual-activity signals plus what historically followed similar signals. Start here for 'what is going on with X?'.

symbol.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE, or a HIP-3 id like xyz:TSLA.

tools.name: get_breadth
tools.description: Participation across the whole venue: share of markets up/down, positioning and regime context. Use to judge whether a move is broad or idiosyncratic.

venue.description: Exchange. hyperliquid = Hyperliquid (Core + HIP-3), aster = Aster, lighter = Lighter.

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Instrument universe for a venue: symbols and ids you can pass to other tools. Optional prefix search.

venue.description: Exchange. hyperliquid = Hyperliquid (Core + HIP-3), aster = Aster, lighter = Lighter.

market_set.description: Hyperliquid only: core perps or HIP-3 builder-deployed markets (e.g. xyz:TSLA). Ignored for other venues.
